1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for such water treatment compounds/formulations as do not have a specific chemical composition, such a compounds of organic origin etc. The primary objective of such compounds is to reduce hardness of water used in boilers and pressure vessels as well as corrosion in the process of internal treatment.
2 REFERENCES
